summary: Validated the new multi-folder picker feature end-to-end on backend (mocked + live preview API). All 12 mocked picker/recursion tests pass (test_folder_picker.py + test_box_recursive_sync.py). 12 regression tests still pass (test_admin_invite_role_scope.py + test_preview_images.py). 4 new live integration tests against the preview backend pass: (1) POST /external-sources persists folder_ids/folder_labels/include_subfolders verbatim; (2) PATCH /folders updates the doc, kicks immediate sync (syncing=true momentarily), and writes a 'listing.source.folders.updated' audit log entry; (3) PATCH with 25 folders returns 400 as documented; (4) GET /browse returns the expected 400 'connection not active' guard when the connected account is fake. COMPOSIO_FILE_SOURCES verified at server.py:4408 with corrected slugs (BOX_LIST_ITEMS_IN_FOLDER, ONE_DRIVE_ONEDRIVE_LIST_ITEMS, DROPBOX_LIST_FILES_IN_FOLDER, DROPBOX_READ_FILE) and SharePoint list+download both None — degrades gracefully. Frontend code review of FolderPickerModal.jsx and ExternalSources.jsx confirms all required data-testids are present (folder-picker-modal, folder-picker-include-subfolders, folder-picker-save, folder-picker-cancel, folder-picker-back, folder-picker-list, source-pick-folders-{sid}, source-folders-{sid}, selected-pill-{id}). Connect form no longer has a folder_id text input — only the source-picker <select>, the Connect button, and the helper text 'After you sign in, you'll be prompted to pick which folder(s) to mirror'. Selected folder pills render via source-folders-{sid} when folder_labels are set. Live modal-open verification in the browser was inconclusive — Playwright login flickered through 3 retries on the demo-account login layout (the right-side login form sits next to a 'Sign in as Seller' demo button, my generic selectors targeted both) — but the Edit panel was confirmed to open inline (visible in a captured screenshot of TEST_Acme_c55ecd edit form). Mira has no pre-seeded ACTIVE Composio source on the preview environment, so the modal cannot be opened via the UI without first completing a real OAuth — out of scope per the request. Main agent can self-verify the modal opens on production where a real Box/Drive connection exists.

minor.issue: When the source's connected account isn't active the endpoint returns 400 with a plain detail string instead of the documented {folders:[], parent_id, can_browse:false, err, source_kind} envelope. Frontend FolderPickerModal handles both shapes (it catches the 400 in its try/catch and displays err), but the spec sentence 'returns {folders:[{id,name}], parent_id, can_browse, err, source_kind}' implies a uniform 200 envelope. Cosmetic, not a functional bug.

action_items: (Optional, nice-to-have) Return the documented 200 {folders, parent_id, can_browse:false, err, source_kind} envelope from /browse when the source isn't active, so the picker can show a friendly 'finish OAuth first' message inside the modal instead of a network error toast.

(Cleanup) Mira's workspace on the preview environment has a stale TEST_Acme_c55ecd listing left over from a previous test iteration — visible in the listings grid screenshot. Recommend running POST /api/admin/demo/purge or deleting it manually.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py crossed 10,000 lines (10,088) — the external-source sync + browse + folder PATCH code now spans ~700 lines (4408-5180) and should be extracted into backend/integrations/external_sources.py with the per-provider browse logic split into one helper per source_kind. Iter-23 flagged this; iter-24 makes it more urgent now that browse + multi-folder iteration code was added.

FolderPickerModal.jsx (370 lines) is dense but readable. Consider extracting the breadcrumb, folder list and selection-pill bar into 3 sub-components if more functionality (search, sort by name, multi-account) is added.

ExternalSourcesCreate Pydantic model still carries the legacy `folder_id: Optional[str]` field. After all production sources are migrated to folder_ids/folder_labels (track this via a one-off mongo aggregation), the legacy field should be deprecated with a 1-release shim that maps folder_id → folder_ids[0]. Right now the seed-row legacy path is silently kept alive in 2 places (ExternalSources.jsx:114-115 and server.py:4995).

/browse guard at server.py:4960-4961 raises HTTPException(400) when status != 'active', which is correct, but the frontend FolderPickerModal's error rendering only shows the upstream detail in the small error banner — consider tagging this case as `requires_oauth: true` in the response body so the modal can render a 'Resume OAuth' button instead of a generic warning.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_folder_picker_live.py is the canonical live-API regression for the multi-folder picker. Run via `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_folder_picker_live.py -v -p no:warnings`. The 4 mocked-only files (test_folder_picker.py, test_box_recursive_sync.py, test_admin_invite_role_scope.py, test_preview_images.py) must NOT be combined in a single pytest invocation — motor's AsyncIOMotorClient is bound to the test event loop and you'll see 'Future attached to a different loop' errors. Run them in separate invocations or per-file. To exercise the modal in a real browser the seller must have an ACTIVE Composio connection (real Box/Drive OAuth) — that's out of scope for preview; verify on production app.nextcapos.com after redeploy.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration validates a feature addition, not a bug fix. All assertions in the original review request passed against the running preview backend except a minor wording discrepancy on the /browse 'connection not active' response shape (documented as 200-envelope, implemented as 400-detail). FolderPickerModal client code transparently handles both shapes.
